high_level_description: The image features a metallic flask with a vintage appearance. The flask is rectangular and has a smooth, reflective surface that gives it a polished look. The top of the flask has a small, rounded cap for sealing. On the front of the flask, there is a printed message that reads: "no alcohol in my flask this is mogu mogu." The text is in a simple, sans-serif font and is positioned centrally on the flask. The background of the image is plain white, which makes the flask stand out prominently.
